compatibility.source: Free on Steam, Windows-only, no known anti-cheat; not yet verified
notes: Free to play, so this is the preset used to prove the Steam install path end to end without buying anything.
Windows-only on Steam, which is what makes it a real test: a game with a native Mac build would not need EasyPlay at all.

hints: Fallout Shelter is free: add it to your Steam library once, then EasyPlay downloads it with SteamCMD.

knownIssues.title: DirectX couldn't start
knownIssues.fix: The DirectX-to-Metal layer didn't load. Switching this game to the built-in renderer usually gets past it.
